第7章 我是大姐大
迎接他的，是一位手握皮鞭的极品小萝莉，正是恶霸二小姐叶雨蝶，“算你识相，少抽你几鞭子！”
只见二小姐大步流星的走进库房，反手将库房门锁住，满意的扫视四周说道：“嗯，不错！是个教训人的好地方，以后你和一号要是敢不听话，就在这里修理你们！”
刘烨心中骇然，怪异的看着二小姐手中悠扬的皮鞭，错愕的问道：“二小姐，您拿着鞭子干什么啊？多伤和气啊？”
“哼，这鞭子可是我的宝贝，快点爬在床上，我要打你屁股！”二小姐嚣张的说道：“不要试图反抗，在叶家没人敢救你，而且这个库房很偏，叫死都不会有人过来！”
“抽…屁股？！”刘烨嘴角**的问道。
“对，就是抽屁股！怕了吧？每次闯祸都是母亲抽我屁股，这次终于轮到我抽别人了，嘎嘎嘎，快点趴下！”二小姐嚣张无比，手中的皮鞭轻轻挥动。
刘烨脸色阴晴不定，自己一个大男人被一个丫头片子抽屁股，是可忍孰不可忍，忍无可忍，无须再忍，“二小姐，够了！我是不会屈服的！”
闻言，二小姐瞪大了眼睛，气鼓鼓的叫道：“哎呀，反了你了！看鞭！”
只见恶霸二小姐挥动皮鞭，直指刘烨的屁股，啪！措不及防之下，刘烨被打了个正着，屁股上顿时传来一阵疼痛，奶奶的，被你老妈爆菊也就算了，你一个小屁孩也来欺负哥？！
“看来不好好教训你这个丫头片子是不行了！”怒火燃烧之下，刘烨已经顾不得那个卖身合同，在二小姐的惊呼声中，一把抢下她手中的皮鞭，扔在一旁，然后将其按在床上。
啪！啪！啪！
一声声嘹亮的拍打声回荡在杂乱的库房中，刘烨直接抄起巴掌就拍了上去，没有丝毫的怜香惜玉，手掌拍打在二小姐娇俏的屁股上，那滋味，别提多爽了！
就好像把这些天来所受的屈辱完全的释放出来一样，“嘿嘿…，一个小丫头片子也敢跟哥嚣张，奶奶的，真舒服！”
话说二小姐被刘烨压在床上，一下子蒙住了，直到自己屁股挨了刘烨的巴掌，才猛然间惊醒，发现自己被小六子死死地压在床上，更加可恨的是，这个胆大妄为的跟班竟然在抽打自己的小屁屁？
自己堂堂叶家二小姐，华北区的大姐大，怎么可以受这样的欺负？
“快放开本小姐，小六子，你竟敢造反？！”恶霸二小姐奋力挣扎着，奈何她根本不是刘烨的对手，感受着自己屁股上那种异样的快感，二小姐心中羞愤不已。
“快放开我，快点，不然我让姐姐杀了你！哎呦~！”
“别拿大小姐来压我，你以为我怕她吗？”刘烨这句话说的有些心虚，想到大小姐身上恐怖的杀气，心中不由打了一个寒颤，既然已经走到这一步，就已经没有退路了。
“小六子，本小姐跟你没完……哎呀，快把你的手放开！”二小姐羞愤的吼叫着，奈何外面根本听不到她的喊叫声。

刘烨狠狠地抽了一下，然后得意的抬起头说道：“小六子也是你能叫的吗？叫六哥！”
“小六子，啊~！”二小姐羞愤欲死，疯狂的挣扎着。
“叫六哥！”刘烨狠狠的抽了一下，恶狠狠的说道。
“六哥……”
在刘烨的淫威之下，华北区一代枭雄叶家二小姐终于屈服了，一张可爱的俏脸上写满了羞愤，泪眼朦胧的大叫着。
看到二小姐屈服，刘烨终于松了口气，心中相当的得意，这个世界上没有什么比征服女人更让人激动的事情了，“这还差不多，还敢不敢告诉你姐姐了？”
“不敢了~！”二小姐委屈的回答道。
“很好，你要是敢告诉你姐姐，我就狠狠的打你的屁股！还有，以后听不听话？”刘烨乘胜追击。
“听…不行，我是大姐大，你是小弟兼职跟班，你听我的才对！”二小姐还没有忘记自己的身份，不甘心的叫嚷着。
“不听话是吧？”刘烨恶狠狠的说道。
“啊…！不要打我屁股，我才是大姐大，你是我的跟班！”二小姐委屈的说道。
刘烨心中大惊，没想到恶霸二小姐性子还挺烈的？真不知道这个大姐大的位置有那个重要吗？
这个时候，忽然间响起了咚咚咚的敲门声，是二小姐的一号跟班王光，“小姐，你就给小六子留口气吧！夫人叫您去开会呢！”
听到王光的声音，库房里的两人终于安静了下来，二小姐脸色羞红一片，被刘烨狠狠的按在床上，眼中闪烁着不屈的目光，“二号，快放开我，我要去开会！”
“这样好了，以后在外人面前我还是你的跟班二号，你还是大姐大，只有我们两个的时候你必须听我的！怎么样？”
“这个…好吧！”二小姐幽幽的说道，眼中闪过一丝皎洁。
听到二小姐答应，刘烨这才满意的松开她，只见二小姐面颊羞红一片，愤愤的看着自己，低声呵斥道：“不要把今天的事情说出去，不然我就跟你拼了！”
“不说，绝对不说，这是我们两个之间的小秘密嘛！”刘烨咧嘴一笑，脸上写满得意。
二小姐羞怯的点点头，狠狠地瞪了刘烨一眼，这才推开库房门走出去，再次恢复了大姐大的模样，跟班一号王光看到二小姐提着皮鞭出来，急忙赔笑道：“二小姐真是越来越有大姐大气质了！”
“哼，赶快跟我开会去，母亲大人又要骂我了！”小丫头得意的哼哼一声，迈着欢快的步子向前走去。

刘烨紧跟着二小姐的脚步出来，嘴角露出一丝玩味，却见王光同情的看着自己，“小六子啊！屁股很疼吧？多亏我来得及时，不然你可就挂掉了！”
“那是那是，多谢王哥！”刘烨撇嘴轻笑，熟练的拍拍马屁。
说罢，两人规规矩矩的跟在二小姐的身后，边走边议论着昨天的事情，王光又开始吹嘘了，“小六子，昨天我本来已经升到8级了，可是为了保护小姐，被一位绝世高手挂掉了，想起来真是悲哀啊！”
“哇，王哥好厉害，小弟才刚刚5级！”刘烨佯装出一副震惊的样子，心中却是好笑不已。
“唉~！等级低不是你的错，但是不努力就是你的错了，有时间我会带你一起升级的，好好努力吧！”王光惆怅的拍拍刘烨的肩膀，然后屁颠屁颠的朝二小姐跟了上去。
刘烨轻笑一声，跟了上去，乘坐磁悬浮电梯，三人很快便来到了叶家的高层会议室，还是同样的情况，他们是最后进来的，二小姐娇笑一声，坐在了夫人的右边。
刘烨和王光自然是规规矩矩的站在二小姐两侧，唯一不同的就是，经过昨天的事情，大小姐和大小姐身边的月落乌啼等人不免多看了刘烨几眼！
更让刘烨心惊的是，身边近在咫尺的叶夫人竟然扭过头诧异的看了自己一眼，刘烨顿时被惊出一身冷汗，叶夫人不会认出自己吧？自己明明没有留下线索啊？
好在叶夫人只是怪异的看了他一眼，然后便恢复了正常，倒是二小姐偷偷地回过头，朝着刘烨嘟了嘟嘴。
刘烨暗笑着摇头，此时的叶夫人已经开始开会，大体内容无非就是总结一晚上众人的练级成果，当在场的游戏高手听说叶夫人就是等级榜第二的月下独赏时，全都忍不住惊呼起来！
当然，刘烨可不会去在乎这些粗浅的会议内容，他的目光再次不由自主的落在了夫人的爆－乳上面。
口水不自觉的流淌出来，“真的好大，手感一定很不错吧？”刘烨心中淫－荡的想着，正当他准备好好意－淫一番的时候，一道凛冽的目光杀了过来！
刺骨的寒冷杀气就好像在刘烨勃－起的阴－茎上浇了一盆冰水，那个滋味，额，不好说，不好说……
收到大小姐的警告，刘烨急忙摆出一副认真聆听的样子，好在这个时候叶夫人正好问到了大小姐，“雨轩，对于等级榜第一的剑红尘你怎么看？”
咦？这不是在谈论我的本尊吗？听到这个问题，刘烨立刻来了兴趣，好奇的打量着大小姐。
“母亲大人，根据我们的情报，剑红尘是紫罗兰财团的人，至于此人的具体身份就不知道了！”大小姐沉重的说道。
闻言，一旁的众人纷纷表示赞同，在他们看来，也只有三大财团才能够培养出这么强大的成员！
只是刘烨清楚的看到，叶夫人在听到三大财团之后，丰盈的娇躯微微颤动了一下，语气惆怅而又坚定的说道：“三大财团吗？总有一天我们叶家会回归的！”
听到这里，刘烨总算明白了些什么，记得自己小时候，华夏国一共有四个一级财团，称为四大财团，除此之外还有四个二级财团，成为四小财团。
当年叶家家主在世的时候，叶家也是强大的一级财团，只是叶家家主过世后，叶家的经济一落千丈，但是依旧是强大的财团，也因为叶家的衰落，如今只剩下了三大财团和五小财团。

月玲珑果然是个很厉害的女人，她是想借助封神的力量将叶家重新打造成一级财团！
果然不愧是华夏国有名的女强人，刘烨打心里佩服叶夫人的勇气！
“大家有谁对剑红尘有所了解？这人的实力怎么样？”叶夫人脸色凝重的问道。
只见坐在大小姐身旁的月落帅哥沉重的回答道：“夫人，我之前见识过此人的厉害，可以肯定，在座的人中，没有人是他的对手，除非我们得到隐藏职业！”
“隐藏职业，谈何容易？！”叶夫人的目光不由黯淡了几分。
“母亲大人，我们叶家不会输给任何人！”大小姐忽然间握紧了叶夫人的手，坚定的说道。
另一边的二小姐也是一样，这一刻，母女三人展现出了前所未有的坚强！令在场的所有人叹服！
不过刘烨很想纠正刚才月落帅哥所说的话，虽然夸剑红尘就等于夸自然，但是自己遇上剑红尘还是很有把握的，要知道，自己可是这个世界上最了解剑红尘的人。
“对！”得到两个女儿的鼓励，叶夫人的脸色再次充满了信心与斗志，起身说道：“感谢各位对叶家的支持，只要叶家存在一天，我绝不会亏待大家！”
“今天的会议就到这里了，大家抓紧时间练级，尽快出新手村就职，今天争取冲到13级！”
说完，叶夫人已经率先冲出了会议室，一副风风火火的样子，似乎想要将自己第一的位置夺回来！
“一号和二号，选择主城的时候记得要去落日城，我们叶家的成员都会选择落日城，到时候本小姐带你们把落日城发展成我们的场子！”二小姐叉着腰对两人说道。
刘烨二人急忙点头赔笑，时不时怕拍马屁，小丫头得意洋洋的瞥了刘烨一眼，拉着大小姐准备回房上线！
刘烨也有些着急，自己那个猎杀大黑熊的任务还没有完成呢，正准备回自己的小库房，刚刚下楼，却见大小姐送走二小姐以后，脸色阴沉的挡住了自己的去路。
“额…大小姐，您找我有什么事吗？”刘烨声音有些颤抖的问道。

Chapter 7 I am the eldest sister
What greeted him was a top-notch little lolita holding a whip in her hand. It was Ye Yudie, the second bully lady. "You know what I'm doing, I'll give you a few less whips!"
The second lady strode into the warehouse, locked the door with her backhand, glanced around with satisfaction and said, "Well, not bad! It's a good place to teach people a lesson. If you and No. 1 dare to be disobedient in the future, I will fix you here!"
Liu Ye was horrified, looking at the whip in the second lady's hand strangely, and asked in astonishment: "Second lady, what are you doing with the whip? How hurtful is it?"
"Hmph, this whip is my treasure. Hurry up and crawl on the bed. I'm going to spank you!" The second lady said arrogantly: "Don't try to resist. No one in the Ye family dares to save you. Moreover, this warehouse is very remote. No one will come here even if you die!"
"Pump...butt?!" Liu Ye asked with a smile on his face.
"Yes, it's just a spanking! Are you scared? Every time I get into trouble, my mother spanks me. This time it's finally my turn to spank someone else. Come on, get down!" The second young lady was so arrogant that she waved the whip lightly in her hand.
Liu Ye's expression was gloomy and uncertain. As a grown man, having his butt slapped by a girl was unbearable. He couldn't bear it any more and there was no need to bear it any longer. "Second Miss, that's enough! I won't give in!"
Hearing this, the second lady's eyes widened and she shouted angrily: "Oh, I've betrayed you! Look at the whip!"
I saw the bully second lady waving the whip and pointing it directly at Liu Ye's butt, bang! Unprepared, Liu Ye was spanked, and there was a sudden pain in his butt. Grandma, it’s okay to be fucked by your mother, but you, a little brat, are here to bully me? !
"Looks like I can't do this without teaching this girl a lesson!" Burning with anger, Liu Ye no longer cared about the sex contract. When the second lady screamed, he snatched the whip from her hand, threw it aside, and then pressed her on the bed.
Snap! Snap! Snap!
Loud slapping sounds echoed in the messy warehouse. Liu Ye directly picked up the slap and slapped it on her without any mercy. The palm of his hand slapped the second young lady's delicate buttocks. The feeling was so satisfying!
It was as if he had completely released the humiliation he had suffered these days, "Hey... a little girl dares to be so arrogant with me, grandma, it's so comfortable!"
It is said that the second lady was pressed on the bed by Liu Ye and was covered for a while. It was not until her butt was slapped by Liu Ye that she suddenly woke up and found that she was pinned down on the bed by Xiao Liuzi. What was even more hateful was that this daring follower was actually spanking her own little butt?
How could I, the second young lady of the Ye family, the eldest sister in North China, be bullied like this?
"Let me go, Xiao Liuzi, how dare you rebel?!" The bully second lady struggled hard, but she was no match for Liu Ye. Feeling the strange pleasure on her butt, the second lady was filled with shame and anger.
"Let me go, hurry up, or I'll let my sister kill you! Ouch~!"
"Don't use the eldest lady to pressure me. Do you think I'm afraid of her?" Liu Ye said this with a guilty conscience. Thinking of the terrifying murderous aura in the eldest lady, he couldn't help but shudder in his heart. Now that he has come to this step, there is no way out.
"Xiao Liuzi, I'm not done with you anymore... Oh, please let go of your hand!" The second young lady yelled in shame and anger, but her shouting could not be heard at all from outside.
Liu Ye slapped him hard, then raised his head proudly and said, "Can you call me Xiao Liuzi? Call me Liu Ge!"
"Xiao Liuzi, ah~!" The second young lady was so ashamed and angry that she struggled wildly.
"Call Sixth Brother!" Liu Ye slapped him hard and said viciously.
"Brother Six..."
Under Liu Ye's lustful power, the second young lady of the Ye family, a powerful figure in North China, finally succumbed. Her lovely face was filled with shame and anger, and her eyes were filled with tears.Yelled hazily.
Seeing the second young lady surrendering, Liu Ye finally breathed a sigh of relief and felt quite proud. There is nothing in this world that is more exciting than conquering a woman. "That's pretty much it. Do you dare to tell your sister?"
"I don't dare~!" the second lady replied aggrievedly.
"Very good, if you dare to tell your sister, I will spank you hard! Also, will you be obedient in the future?" Liu Ye pursued the victory.
"Listen... no, I am the eldest sister, and you are my younger brother's part-time follower. You should listen to me!" The second young lady has not forgotten her identity and shouted unwillingly.
"You're disobedient, aren't you?" Liu Ye said viciously.
"Ah...! Don't spank me, I am the eldest sister and you are my follower!" the second young lady said aggrievedly.
Liu Ye was shocked. He didn't expect the bully second lady to be quite violent. I really don’t know if this eldest sister’s position is that important?
At this time, there was a sudden knock on the door. It was Wang Guang, the number one follower of Miss Er, saying, "Miss, please give Xiao Liuzi a break! Madam has asked you to go to a meeting!"
Hearing Wang Guang's voice, the two people in the warehouse finally became quiet. The second lady's face turned red with embarrassment. Liu Ye pressed her down hard on the bed, with an unyielding look in her eyes. "No. 2, let me go quickly. I have to go to a meeting!"
"That's good. From now on, I will still be your second follower in front of outsiders, and you will still be the eldest sister. When we are alone, you must listen to me! How about it?"
"This...okay!" the second young lady said quietly, a glint of brightness flashed in her eyes.
After hearing the second lady's promise, Liu Ye let go of her with satisfaction. The second lady's cheeks turned red with embarrassment. She looked at him angrily and scolded him in a low voice: "Don't tell what happened today, or I will fight with you!"
"Don't tell me, absolutely don't tell me, this is a little secret between the two of us!" Liu Ye grinned, with pride written all over his face.
The second young lady nodded shyly, glared at Liu Ye fiercely, then opened the warehouse door and walked out, regaining her eldest sisterly appearance. Follower No. 1 Wang Guang saw the second young lady coming out with a whip, and hurriedly smiled and said: "The second young lady is really becoming more and more like a big sister!"
"Hmph, hurry up and have a meeting with me, mother is going to scold me again!" The little girl snorted proudly and walked forward with cheerful steps.
Liu Ye followed the second lady's footsteps and came out with a trace of amusement on his lips, but he saw Wang Guang looking at him sympathetically, "Little Liuzi! Does your butt hurt? Thank you I came in time, otherwise you would have died!"
"That's right, that's right, thank you, Brother Wang!" Liu Ye curled his lips and chuckled, flattering him skillfully.
After that, the two of them followed the second young lady in an orderly manner, talking about yesterday's events as they walked. Wang Guang started to brag again, "Xiao Liuzi, yesterday I was promoted to level 8, but in order to protect the young lady, I was killed by a peerless master. It's really sad to think about it!"
"Wow, Brother Wang is so awesome, and I'm only at level 5!" Liu Ye pretended to be shocked, but he was actually very amused.
"Oh~! It's not your fault that your level is low, but it's your fault that you don't work hard. I will take you to level up when I have time, so work hard!" Wang Guang patted Liu Ye's shoulder melancholy, and then followed the second lady in a hurry.
Liu Ye chuckled lightly and followed him. They took the maglev elevator and the three of them soon arrived at the high-rise conference room of the Ye family. It was the same situation. They were the last ones to come in. The second lady gave a sweet smile and sat on the right side of the madam.
Liu Ye and Wang Guang naturally stood on either side of the second young lady in an orderly manner. The only difference was that after what happened yesterday, the eldest lady and Yueluowutiao and others beside the eldest lady couldn't help but look at Liu Ye a few more times!
What shocked Liu Ye even more was that Mrs. Ye, who was very close to him, turned her head and looked at him in surprise.At one glance, Liu Ye was suddenly startled and broke into a cold sweat. Mrs. Ye wouldn't recognize him, would she? You obviously didn’t leave any clues?
Fortunately, Mrs. Ye just looked at him strangely and then returned to normal. However, the second lady turned back secretly and pouted at Liu Ye.
Liu Ye smiled secretly and shook his head. At this time, Mrs. Ye had already started a meeting. The general content was nothing more than a summary of everyone's leveling results overnight. When the game masters present heard that Mrs. Ye was the second best person in the level list, they all couldn't help but exclaimed!
Of course, Liu Ye didn't care about the superficial content of the meeting. His eyes once again involuntarily fell on his wife's big breasts.
His saliva flowed out unconsciously, "It's really big. It must feel good in the hand, right?" Liu Ye thought lustfully in his heart. Just when he was about to have a good show of lust, a piercing gaze came over him!
The biting cold murderous aura was like pouring a basin of ice water on Liu Ye's erect penis. The taste, well, it's hard to describe, it's hard to describe...
After receiving the warning from the eldest lady, Liu Ye hurriedly pretended to listen carefully. Fortunately, at this time, Mrs. Ye happened to ask the eldest lady, "Yuxuan, what do you think of Jian Hongchen, who is number one on the level list?"
Huh? Isn't this talking about my true self? Upon hearing this question, Liu Ye immediately became interested and looked at the eldest lady curiously.
